The '''Nimgorrhean saber-wasp''', also known as just a '''saber-wasp''', was a flying [[Insect/Legends|insect]] from the [[Nimgorrhea system/Legends|Nimgorrhea system]].

[[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Ordo Skirata]] likened [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Nyreen Vollen]]'s usual grim expression to someone who looked like they continuously chewed saber-wasps.
